purpose: Record command family file ownership, import buckets, split readiness, blockers, and required gates before any future package split.
policy: Do not split cmd/gofly/internal/command by package until a family has stable file ownership, isolated imports, CLI JSON and help contract coverage, and a rollback path. Package splits must move one family at a time.

candidateRequirements: family has no direct gofly runtime imports outside the command package
family has a narrow command surface and stable help output
family has dedicated package tests or CLI JSON golden coverage
family can move without changing public CLI command names, flags, aliases, or JSON fields
rollback restores the previous single-package command layout in one commit

families.domain: AI planning, manifest, governance, and project apply commands
blockers: AI commands share control-plane, LLM, failover, streaming, manifest, project apply, and JSON output contracts.
The family is large and includes tests plus helper types that are still tightly coupled to shared command package utilities.
requiredPreSplitActions: extract shared AI manifest and output helpers behind package-private adapters
separate control-plane provider wiring from CLI flag parsing
add package-level CLI JSON golden coverage after any extraction
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore AI files to cmd/gofly/internal/command and keep command names, flags, JSON fields, and manifest output unchanged.

families.domain: API format, import, route, diff, codegen, docs, middleware, and client commands
blockers: API commands still depend on the shared generator package and CLI file/path helpers.
The command family owns several external contract surfaces, including format, import, diff, docs, middleware, and client output.
requiredPreSplitActions: isolate generator-facing command adapters
pin API command help and JSON contracts before moving files
prove API import, format, and diff command behavior stays stable
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore API command files to the current package if API help, JSON, format, import, or diff output changes unexpectedly.

families.domain: RPC IDL, protoc, descriptor, scaffold, template, and auxiliary commands
blockers: RPC commands depend on generator, spinner, and runtime RPC descriptor packages.
Descriptor and protoc behavior are external CLI contracts that need stable golden coverage before any package split.
requiredPreSplitActions: separate descriptor rendering from command flag parsing
pin protoc and descriptor JSON output before moving files
prove rpc-boundary evidence remains unchanged after extraction
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore RPC command files to the current package if descriptor, protoc, scaffold, or template behavior changes.

families.domain: Model DDL, datasource, Mongo, MySQL, Postgres, and output commands
blockers: Model commands are generator-facing and include datasource-specific options that are still shared with command helpers.
Future model/cache governance should stabilize generated output before the command family moves.
requiredPreSplitActions: extract model option normalization behind a focused adapter
pin datasource command outputs and generated model diff reports
prove generated project dependency hygiene stays unchanged
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore model command files if model datasource output, generated go.mod behavior, or cache template evidence drifts.

families.domain: New service, API, RPC, goctl compatibility, discovery overlay, and scaffold commands
blockers: New commands own service, API, RPC, goctl compatibility, profile, contract, and scaffold paths as one generated-output surface.
Generated-output determinism and cross-version fixture checks are higher priority than package movement.
requiredPreSplitActions: separate profile parsing from scaffold execution
pin generated project compile smoke before moving files
prove goctl-compatible flags and JSON output remain stable
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore new command files if generated service, API, RPC, profile, or goctl-compatible scaffold output changes unexpectedly.

families.domain: Plugin registry, install, run, plan, and mode commands
blockers: Plugin commands are security-sensitive because they touch registry, install, run, digest, permissions, and external process boundaries.
Generator and spinner dependencies should be wrapped before package movement changes the trust boundary.
requiredPreSplitActions: isolate plugin execution and registry adapters behind explicit interfaces
pin no-partial-write and permission escape evidence before moving files
run plugin conformance after any package split
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore plugin command files immediately if registry, install, run, digest, permission, or isolation evidence changes.

families.domain: Release check, local checks, contract checks, output, and helper commands
blockers: Release commands own artifact, contract, local check, and JSON output evidence used by CI and release governance.
Package movement must not change release evidence fields or skip-gate behavior.
requiredPreSplitActions: pin release check JSON output with golden tests
isolate local shell command execution from output rendering
prove release artifact gate evidence remains unchanged
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore release command files if release check JSON, artifact evidence, or required-check drift output changes.

families.domain: Doctor diagnostics, checks, tests, and support remediation output
blockers: Doctor is already extracted through P22-14 and should not move again until adapter usage is reduced.
Future doctor work must preserve diagnostics, JSON output fields, stdout/stderr boundaries, support bundle references, and command registration.
requiredPreSplitActions: keep doctor diagnostics and next action wording pinned with golden coverage
keep the command package doctor adapter minimal until shared helpers are reduced
verify CLI JSON, support bundle, stdout/stderr, and command registration gates after future doctor edits
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore doctor files to the command package if diagnostics, JSON fields, stdout, or stderr discipline changes.

families.domain: Help catalog, topics, metadata, usage, and rendering
blockers: Help is already extracted through P22-12 and should not be moved again until adapter usage is reduced.
Future help work must preserve exact user-facing text, topic aliases, stdout routing, and docs synchronization.
requiredPreSplitActions: keep help output and topic rendering pinned with golden coverage
keep the command package help adapter minimal until shared helpers are reduced
verify docs-check still covers every help topic after future help edits
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore help files to the command package and remove help_adapter.go if help text, topic routing, usage output, or docs synchronization changes.

families.domain: Configuration command and config field helpers
blockers: Config commands are small but still depend on generator config structs and field helper behavior.
A split should first isolate config mutation from CLI parsing and output rendering.
requiredPreSplitActions: extract generator config field mutation behind a focused adapter
pin config command JSON and help output
prove config file read/write behavior remains path-safe
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore config command files if config mutation, validation, JSON output, or generated config compatibility changes.

families.domain: Shared root command wiring, CLI helpers, compatibility commands, IDL helpers, template helpers, example commands, and low-level command utilities without a stable prefix.
blockers: Shared files contain root command wiring, JSON error output, file input, path flags, template helpers, IDL helpers, tests, and compatibility commands.
This group is the dependency source for many prefixed families and should be reduced before any package split.
requiredPreSplitActions: extract root wiring, JSON output, file input, and template helper subdomains into smaller file families
keep shared helpers in place while refreshing the next single-family candidate
pin full CLI help, JSON error, and generated-output contracts
families.rollbackRequirement: Restore shared files to the command package and keep root command registration, JSON errors, IDL helpers, and template behavior unchanged.
